speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) will strive to deliver our mission of ensuring Singapore’s safety and security by transforming the Home Team for greater operational readiness and effectiveness and strengthening our engagement with the community and international partners.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Criminal syndicates exploit technology and the Internet and operate across national boundaries.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Online scams and online trafficking of drugs have become more prevalent.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Our society has also been impacted by the worsening global drug situation, with new psychoactive substances emerging, and some countries adopting a more liberal approach towards drugs.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We need to guard against attempts by foreign parties to exploit fault lines in our society and influence developments in Singapore to advance their own agenda.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: It is for Singaporeans to decide on our domestic politics and policies.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We must defend our sovereign right to make choices for ourselves.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Our racial and religious harmony has been a pillar of our peace, prosperity and progress.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We must defend this vigorously, reject unequivocally teachings and practices that would divide us, and instead take active steps to grow our common space.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Home Team will have to deal with these security challenges even as we grapple with manpower constraints.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will take bold and transformative steps to develop stronger capabilities, leverage emerging technology for operations, deepen the proficiencies of our officers, and strengthen laws where necessary to enhance the Home Team’s effectiveness.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Home Team's joint capabilities will span the areas of operations, investigation and intelligence.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The new Home Team Operations Centre will be a nerve centre which will employ cutting-edge technologies and harness data to ensure a swift and coordinated Home Team response to incidents.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will further integrate our island-wide network of cameras and sensors to enhance sense-making and enable us to identify and deal effectively with security threats and criminal activities.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will make a strong push in digital transformation and robotics.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) will continue to integrate robotics, such as the use of exo-skeletons, into its operations to improve the safety and capabilities of our firefighters.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) will employ more biometric solutions to tighten border security but will also facilitate more efficient immigration clearance through the use of automated clearance for cars.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Police investigation process will be digitalised, while the Central Narcotics Bureau (CNB) will trial the use of automation for urine testing.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Singapore Prison Service (SPS) will use business intelligence tools to automate routine work, and video analytics to enhance supervision of inmates.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: These initiatives will free up our officers’ time, allowing them to perform more complex and higher value-added tasks, and improve their productivity and effectiveness.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to invest heavily in our people.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Home Team officers will have more training opportunities to keep abreast of digital transformation and the changing operational environment.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Officers will be cross-trained to reap synergies and optimise resources.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will build up the capacity and capabilities of our Emergency Medical Services to deliver better emergency response outcomes while meeting the growing demand for such services.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will enhance our service delivery to the public with more convenient e-services and platforms.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: ICA has developed "MyICA", a web portal which allows citizens to access a full range of e-services with a single login.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Police Hub is a convenient one-stop portal for the public to lodge reports, provide feedback and check on transactions.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will complete a fundamental review of the Penal Code, where a significant focus has been placed on enhancing protection for vulnerable persons.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will build on our strong community networks and high levels of public trust, to leverage the collective strength of the community to deal with threats to Singapore’s safety and security.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Our security response to the terrorism threat must be complemented by community vigilance and resilience.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SGSecure will continue to be one of our priorities in this area.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Since the launch of SGSecure, we have made good progress in raising public awareness about the threat of terrorism.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will next focus on enhancing the community’s preparedness to respond to such threats.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: At workplaces, we will develop advisories to enhance the capabilities of premises owners and small businesses in contingency planning and protective security.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In schools, we will train our students in first aid and emergency drills.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will equip grassroots leaders and volunteers with emergency response skills, such as enabling them to perform psychological first aid to mitigate post-attack trauma.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to partner the community to prevent radical ideologies from taking root in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also continue to promote our Community First Responders (CFRs) programme.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to partner the community in the rehabilitation and reintegration of offenders.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SPS will conduct more programmes for inmates and their families.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: With the support of Singaporeans, the Home Team will make Singapore a safe and secure home.
